title: Cookie box covers the bottom third of the phone screen on arrival
what_happened: As soon as the page opened, a cookie box covered the bottom of my screen, right over the paragraph explaining what they do. Not the whole page, so I'll deal with it, but it's in the way.
expected: A thin strip at the bottom that doesn't hide what I'm trying to read.

title: Opening words don't say who they help, and lean on buzzwords
what_happened: "Cross-functional or cross-industry, structured or unstructured" — I don't know what that means for me. It says they build AI solutions, but not for whom, or what that looks like for a company like mine.
expected: One plain line like "We help small and mid-sized businesses use AI to cut paperwork", or an example.

title: Three screens in and still nothing about who they work with; examples are consultant-speak
what_happened: I scrolled three screens. It says "every company", then "market assessments, go-to-market strategy, operational leverage". Nothing says whether a twelve-person cleaning company or a food pantry is someone they'd work with, and no real example like "we cut a client's invoicing time in half". This reads like it's for big corporations.
expected: Early on, a line about the size or kind of clients they take (small businesses, nonprofits), and one plain example of the help.
